title: Cohort explorer
idea: Cohort explorer: A cohort matrix keeps sample size and date definitions visible
audience: People who need to analyze retention within a dashboard surface.
worksWellWhen: Return behavior depends on starting groups
avoidWhen: The dataset is too small for conclusions
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic instrument layout through its analyze retention priority and explicit commitment contract: Label missing data and avoid implying causation
navigation: Cohort explorer keeps the current analyze retention context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A cohort matrix keeps sample size and date definitions visible
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to analyze retention; return behavior depends on starting groups
composition.priority: Label missing data and avoid implying causation

imagery.role: Support the actual analyze retention context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Provide readable table alternative to dense heatmap
Keep units, filters and selection understandable at narrow widths; expose a focused item view.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the cohort explorer structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no analyze retention content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Label missing data and avoid implying causation
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized analyze retention content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Label missing data and avoid implying causation
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active analyze retention context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure bounded queries and large-data interaction; virtualize only with accessible alternatives.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
